slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 20% annual profit for project (1) calculated on the amount invested at the beginning of each year, with the principal and profit both available for reinvestment at the beginning of the following year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly checks project (1) investment across the beginning of each year, and the user confirms this multi-year timing, resolving the hidden timing flexibility.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 20% annual profit for project (1) earned at the end of each year and added to the available cash for the following year, or is it a one-time return at the end of the three-year period?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asks whether project (1) returns are available for reinvestment in the following year, and later confirms principal plus profit are both reinvestable.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 150% total return for project (2) received at the end of the second year, making it available for reinvestment at the beginning of the third year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirms the recovery date of project (2) as the end of the second year and its availability for reinvestment in year 3.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can the initial 300,000 yuan be invested in projects (3) and (4) at the beginning of the first year, or are these projects only available for investment in later years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asks about project (3)'s investment timing and the user clarifies it is only available at the beginning of the second year, resolving the timing restriction.

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can the initial 300,000 yuan be invested in projects (3) and (4) at the beginning of the first year, or are these projects only available for investment in later years?

summary: The agent conducted a focused clarification interview, explicitly checking the key timing, recovery, and reinvestment facts for projects (1) through (4) before declaring readiness to model.
